about: Pre-patch official stats (competitive role queue, all ranks, all maps) for every balance patch since per-hero ban rates were published, with the clear buffs (+1) and nerfs (-1) of each patch. Blizzard regions from the season snapshots archived by github.com/hermit-crab/ow-winrates-faceted, China from the same archive (ban share x4 = per-match rate), Korea and the 2026-10-14 / 2026-11-04 patches from this site's archive. Pick rates are per-slot shares (role sums 100/200/200).
